name: highway_materials
character: A night national highway: wet asphalt, sealed concrete barriers, a concrete tunnel bore, a steel flyover deck and open air above.
note: Absorption coefficients per octave band. The facade value follows the reported facade reflection coefficient of 0.9-0.95 (energy absorption 1 - R^2 = 0.10-0.19); asphalt, concrete, glass and the steel deck are starting values. Quiet Frequency: the same asphalt, barrier, underpass and steel-deck materials as the Highway Pursuit cue, copied into this project.
sources: research note: Real-world references: tunnel_air (a street canyon facade reflects 0.9-0.95 of the sound; an underpass rings longer than a street)
ESTIMATE: wet asphalt, steel deck, glass and painted concrete are starting values; the library values for glass and concrete are from Everest & Pohlmann (room_materials)
